Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: Activities, Molecule_Dictionary, Compound_Structures. Join: Activities to Molecule_Dictionary via molregno. Molecule_Dictionary to Compound_Structures via molregno. Filter: assay_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217643'. Filter: standard_value IS NOT NULL. Filter: standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Filter: standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, molecule_chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
